newsitem.title: INDIA: BT to pay about 60 mln stg for Bharti stake.
newsitem.headline: BT to pay about 60 mln stg for Bharti stake.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc will pay about 60 million pounds sterling for the 22.5 percent stake it intends to buy in Bharti Cellular Ltd, British government officials said on Friday.

Earlier on Friday, British Telecom announced in New Delhi that it had applied to the Indian government to take over GMC, a subsidiary of France's CGE group with a 22.5 percent stake in Bharti Cellular.
British officials travelling with visiting Prime Minister John Major said the stake would cost British Telecom about 60 million sterling.
A British Telecom executive in New Delhi later confirmed the figure.
